mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inventory_item WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM inventory_item WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid AND item_type = #{itemType}::item_type ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT * FROM inventory_item WHERE adventure_gained_item_id = #{gainedItemId}::uuid LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_item (id, character_id, adventure_entry_id, adventure_gained_item_id, item_name, item_type, rarity, requires_attunement, quantity, source, notes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}::uuid, #{characterId}::uuid, CAST(#{adventureEntryId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), CAST(#{adventureGainedItemId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{itemName}, #{itemType}::item_type, CAST(#{rarity, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS item_rarity), COALESCE(#{requiresAttunement}, false), #{quantity}, #{source}, #{notes}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_item SET adventure_entry_id = CAST(#{adventureEntryId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), adventure_gained_item_id = CAST(#{adventureGainedItemId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), item_name = #{itemName}, item_type = #{itemType}::item_type, rarity = CAST(#{rarity, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS item_rarity), requires_attunement = COALESCE(#{requiresAttunement}, false), quantity = #{quantity}, source = #{source}, notes = #{notes}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
